*Notes

Blinkbat: +50 Defense VS. Missile: Reduces the % chance of getting hit by missiles (by raising the effective armor rating)
10% Faster Run/Walk will stack with speed increasing boots to make you Run/Walk even faster.
Twitchthroe: Adds 25% Blocking to Shield Blocking, will only work with a Shield.
Sparking Mail: Attacker Takes Lightning Damage will not work with ranged weapons.
Iceblink: Iceblink works with Ranged Weapons. Learn more about the freeze duration here (scroll down)
Goldskin: Attacker Takes Damage of 10 will not work with ranged weapons.
